focus: Explain the measured keep from scorer mechanics, corpus construction, label balance, and the recorded run arithmetic.
noveltyJustification: Six result drivers recomputed from four distinct artifacts; the exact-token avoidance in the corpus and the forced K/3 majority baseline are new to the packet record.

ruledOut: Treat the 8-case fixture census as the fallback's measured population: all 8 fixture cases hit the pattern and contribute no fallback rows.
Treat loose 0 of 24 as a property of the rule alone: the corpus avoids the exact tokens by construction while carrying inflected near-misses.
Treat p_win=0.00001526 as an error probability: it is a sign-test tail over discordance manufactured by the balanced labels and a one-third baseline.
focusTrackReason: The first pass follows the printed verdict back through the scorer's decision functions, the corpus text, the labels, and the recorded calls.

title: The keep clears every gate, with the sign test binding
claim: At K=M=24, A=24, B=8, W=16, L=0, F=0 the coverage, kill, margin and flip gates all pass; the sign test p_win is 2^-16 = 1.5259e-5. Recomputing at n=16, W=12 is the smallest passing win count (p=0.0384); W=11 fails (p=0.105).

title: The chosen baseline is the majority class at exactly K/3
claim: chooseBaseline prefers the loose rule only when it is at least as good; labels are pass 8, fail 8, block 8, loose right is 0 and majority right is 8, so majority is chosen and B=8 equals one third of K by construction.

title: The corpus hard-codes the miss and disables the loose rule
claim: All 24 outputs contain zero whole-word pass/fail/block tokens while carrying inflected forms (fails x2, failed, failure, passed, blocker x3); extractVerdict needs an alone-on-a-line verdict and loosePick needs whole tokens, so both zero-call readers are evaded by construction.

title: The measured population is the outputs file, not the fixtures
claim: The run prints fixture cases 8 hits 8 misses 0 and outputs rows 24 hits 0 misses 24; every shipped reviewer fixture writes a VERDICT line, so the fallback's natural-miss rate is unmeasured and the arm scored only the 24 synthetic reports.

title: Jev scored a unanimous stable column on this population
claim: 73 calls (1 auth plus 24 rows x 3 orders) all recorded measured; modal pick equals label on all 24 rows; F=0; minimum pick probability 0.96, mean 0.998; p50 334 ms, p95 377 ms; model jev-1.13.0 under jev 0.6.2, provider official, labels_sha256 matching the measured file.

title: Labels equal the author's intent on all 24 rows
claim: The committed intent file cycles pass/fail/block by id and the measured labels match it 24 of 24; the corpus is recorded as written by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with a blind delegated arbiter whose labels matched the author's intent; the committed scratch fixture is the same 24 texts without a label field.
